proud: a. 骄傲的, 自大的, 自豪的, 辉煌的, 壮丽的
a. feeling self-respect or pleasure in something by which you measure your self-worth; or being a reason for pride
proudest: a. 自豪的, 骄傲的；(因受表扬等而)感到光荣的, 引以为荣的
proudful: a. <方>充满自豪的,非常骄傲的
proudhearted: a. 骄傲的, 傲慢的
proudly: adv. 傲慢地, 自大地, 得意洋洋地
r. with pride; in a proud manner
proustian: 普鲁士的, 普鲁斯特的（proust的形容词形式）
a. of or relating to or in the manner of Marcel Proust
